LanguageData.RatkinQL_RefugeeTree_Report: A refugee Ratkin has arrived, seeking shelter.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_Greeting: A haggard Ratkin stands at the door. He sets down his only bag and begs {Interviewer_labelShort} for a place to stay.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_OptTakeIn: Take him in. Let him join the colony.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_OptStory: Ask where he came from and what happened.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_OptSupplies: Can't take him in, but give him some supplies (5 hardtack).
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_Story1: Warlord's men burned our village. Those who ran were shot.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_Story2: Famine scattered everyone. I walked until I could not feel my feet.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_Story3: Rakinia and RKU tore our home apart. I was one of the lucky ones.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_Farewell: He nods once, his fate weighing on his shoulders.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_MsgJoin: With tears in his eyes, he bows in solemn respect. This will be his new home.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Refugee_MsgSupplies: He takes the rations, murmurs thanks, and drags his tired body onward.
